header: The supply terms in plain language
intro: The short version of our terms of sale and delivery. It lets buyers check the points that usually decide an order before the legal review starts. This page is a reading aid, and only the full document is binding.

items.title: How long a price holds
items.summary: Quoted prices are valid for 30 days. Alloy surcharges are charged at the rate on the day we order the material. They appear as a separate line on the invoice.

items.title: When a delivery counts as accepted
items.summary: A delivery counts as accepted when the parts are installed or when ten working days pass after goods-in without a complaint to Graz. The earlier date applies.

items.title: Tooling and the drawings you send us
items.summary: Tooling we invoice to you stays in our plants so we can maintain it. Ownership passes to you on final payment. We use your drawings only for your orders and never show them to another customer.
